colors.certificate: warm ivory with fine gold detailing

motion.background: slow ambient glow, stars, and occasional meteors
motion.interaction: short hover, press, focus, and generated-certificate feedback

patterns: responsive desktop artwork overlay and mobile-first generator

must: Preserve the Back to Base black, gold, and ivory visual identity.
Keep supplied certificate artwork and participant-name placement intact.
Keep the existing no-build static deployment and PNG/PDF workflows.
Keep the form comfortable to use on mobile and desktop.
avoid: Do not introduce a framework or unnecessary runtime dependencies.
Avoid loud or lengthy interaction animations that slow the certificate workflow.
Do not alter the certificate artwork or its content.

decisions.decision: Keep the existing premium layout and use concise tactile feedback on controls plus a brief certificate reveal to make the interface feel more responsive.
